about_the_game:
When a blacksmith’s birthright is stolen by evil Blacklords, he must draw upon the might of an ambiguously empowered sword...

It matters not that he doesn’t know what his birthright is, nor what the sword is—all he knows is that its power is apparent and indisputable. Is it the power to slice? The power to dice, cut things, or be sheathed? Is it the power of electro-conductivity, mind control, or one-and-a-half-speed corrosion? All of the above? He intends to find out and use these irrefutable powers to slaughter chickens, solve puzzles, and bring the Blacklord his comeuppance.

This is an absurd comedy adventure game whose engine, code, art, story, and soundtrack were made by a single person.

  • It's like a 2D Zelda, but in 3D.

  • Absurd, funny story and dialogue.

  • About three hours of gameplay.

  • Dungeons & Collectables

  • Sokoban-style box pushing puzzles

  • Fight chickens and other familiar enemies in fun, frantic combat.

  • Redeem your birthright (maybe).

  • Defeat the Blacklord by being good at the game (also maybe).

It’s full of puzzles, chuckles, and tough combat. It’s the perfect way to spend a lazy Sunday afternoon or an intense Sunday evening.

The new version, New Tower of Fire: The Sword of Unspoken Miscellaneous Things - HD Remaster: Game of the Decade Edition, brings a year’s worth of post-launch development, adding a bigger world with more puzzles, secrets, and enemies, funnier writing, quality-of-life improvements, movement and combat tweaks, and a major graphics and sound overhaul. The game is now twice as big and twice as polished.
detailed_description:
Insanely Massive Update / Overhaul: Version 2.0!

Thanks to a year of post-launch development and improvements, I'm happy to announce New Tower of Fire: The Sword of Unspoken Miscellaneous Things: H.D. Remaster: Game of the Decade Edition.

NToFtSoUMTHDRGotDE adds:

  • A bigger, more open world

  • Way more secrets

  • Major graphics and sound improvements

  • Story refinements with punchier, funnier dialog and writing

  • Tighter combat and movement

  • More enemies, sokoban style puzzles to battle and areas to travel through

  • Test your logic with carefully designed push-the-box challenges.

  • Refined UI, world map and quality of life improvements
